rejection_reasons_top.reason: trade rate 40/h exceeds profile cap of 40/h

notes: Snapshot long terme : bougies 240min (4h) x 720 bougies = ~120 jours. Le spec demandait 60min x 90j (option C2) mais Kraken plafonne sa profondeur OHLC tokenized_asset a ~720 bougies par intervalle ; 60m x 90j (= 2160 bougies) n'est PAS recuperable, donc fallback C1 240m x 120j (1 appel, sans pagination).

Profil aggressive_competition calibre pour 60min x 30j ; sur 120 jours x 4h, des changements de regime hors fenetre d'entrainement degradent le win rate. MDD = 13.34% reflete des phases adverses reelles (pas un bug pagination ni doublon).
Equity curve is a step function over realised events. Per-candle mark-to-market is not surfaced in the canonical payload.
Per-trade Sharpe is computed on SELL pnls; not annualised.
Trade pairs are FIFO-matched BUY → SELL inside each symbol.

Backtest analysis variant: per-symbol cooldown disabled (cooldown_seconds_per_symbol = 0). The risk layer's cooldown uses time.time() (wall clock), which does not advance during candle replay; the override lets the strategy re-enter on successive signals over the full window. Live and paper engines keep the cooldown gate enabled.
